reason: In testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/AssertEvents.java:480-483, isAccessTokenId splits item on ':' and only checks items.length != 2 before calling items[0].substring(3, 5). Because items[0].length() is never validated, any colon-separated value whose prefix has fewer than 5 characters throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of returning false.
